details:
Forwarded from the r/VRchat sub-reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/VRchat/comments/1y7ccqs/negative_user_count_glitch_i_saw_yesterday_anyone/

Steps to reproduce: Uncertain. Some comments from the topic include:

- u/0nivas reports: I think it's because of the new ui thingy to make instances, for some worlds when I tried to make instance it just bug and teleport me to my home world again, the instance still exist but it show a negative 1, everytime I tried to join the instance again the number goes down again, can have a negative 3 instance, it's also show "253/32" as the number of people in it at the top of the portal when you make one. so probably a fresh new bug.

- u/Spuigles reports: Okay so. when a user leaves a world. It ticks down 1, when someone join it ticks 1tick up. But if an instance is empty and about to be deleted (as empty instances do), and a player quits "slowly", it ticks an additional time before getting cleared. Its actually possible to get that in a lot of places. If you make a reddit post, write a comment, then delete it quickly, it will say -1 comments.

Expected result: Instances with negative or 0 users should not be visible to the user; negative user counts should be impossible.

Actual result: The attached screenshot shows negative (-1) users in an instance. The client may show instances with negative user counts.
title: Negative user counts in the instance list
